name: full-stack-tic-tac-toe
description: Full-stack Tic-Tac-Toe (YOU vs AI): React + Express + PostgreSQL, deployed on Vercel with Neon.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.preview: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm start -w backend" "npm run preview -w frontend"
scripts.test: node --test "scripts/*.test.mjs" && npm test -w backend && npm test -w frontend
